## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and relevant failure boundaries.
- [ ] Public API, CLI, or JSON documentation is updated when needed.
- [ ] The change preserves deterministic routing and directed-edge semantics.
- [ ] No secrets, generated artifacts, or local configuration are included.
- [ ] Compatibility and performance implications are described above.
